notes: No news story found naming loanDepot's 2015-17 refinance denial rate or the 74% vs 8% purpose split. Closest: Fannie Mae 2019 research table gives loanDepot.com a 76% refinance denial rate in rural areas over 2012-2017, same direction, different geography and window. CFPB 2017 Data Point gives the market-wide pattern (refis denied ~2.5x purchase) with no lender named. Federal Reserve 2016 HMDA article (federalreserve.gov) and St. Louis Fed May 2026 'Determinants of Mortgage Denial' were opened: neither compares refinance vs purchase denial by lender nor names loanDepot. A National Mortgage News item on a Maryland couple's settled racial-bias suit over a denied loanDepot refinance exists but is a single-application appraisal case, not a rate finding; not recorded. Fannie Mae date is from the report cover.
